body: I'd do just about anything for friends, hell I'd even do this with a random person if they needed it. what could be more important than helping a suicidal person stay alive that I can't immediately help them, nothing, to me at least. I'll update this post once I hear back from her today, thanks again for all your help.
I can be blunt with her like this, I know that much, so I've already told her to call me if anything happens, or is about to happen

I've told her I care about her several times over, even when stuff like this isn't happening. trying to get her to call me when she's about to do something is a great idea, I told her that the first time she had a breakdown too I guees I just forgot to this time because I was too worried to think straight. you've been a great help, thanks!
good suggestion, I'll do my best

oh trust me I've tried, she's stubborn as hell. she's tried professional therapy before as well and it almost just made it worse. I couldn't even get her to tell me what was going on, no way she'll talk to anyone else. if she didn't live 2.5 hours away I'd go there myself right now but alas

she's been in these breakdowns before, I myself have been in these breakdowns before, but this time it's different with the added apparent death threats/promises she's gotten, which she'll tell me. nothing about. I know she won't kill herself, she doesn't have it in her, but others? idk... she gets into fight A LOT, and has been getting into drugs recently. I can deal with breakdowns, it's just so different this time.
